answer: Proof of Personhood protocols mitigate Sybil attacks by requiring agents to undergo verifiable biometric or social-graph validation. An attacker attempting to scale a sable army of identities faces a sharp ledge of computational and financial expenditure to bypass uniqueness tests. Each malicious actor acts like a falcon hunting for vulnerabilities, yet the systemic cost of generating verified digital proxies remains prohibitively expensive, ensuring honest participation remains the only path to economic utility.
